thread:
aj: Quick check — we need 8x H100 (RDMA-enabled) in apac-southeast1 for a loadtest next Tue 08:00 UTC. Anyone see spare quota or a quick bump path? Trying to avoid cross-region routing if possible.

maria: I ran a quota scan this morning — apac-southeast1 shows 0 spare H100 quota in our org. We have a pending GCP quota request (5873) but it's still open with support.

saurav: tagging perf: are we RDMA-dependent for this test or can we validate with GPUDirect/A100 fallback?

aj: RDMA preferred for the network-heavy model shard tests. Fallback ok but would change perf profile.

ken: We could borrow 4x H100 from the demo pool in apac-west1 for a partial run, but that requires disabling MIG and updating the nodepool taints. Also cross-region latency might affect results.

leah: Procurement update: Nimbus vendor replied — they can reserve 2 racks with RDMA-capable NICs, lead time 3-4 weeks. They offered expedited staging-only delivery if we sign an NDA. Procurement ticket PR-9442.

ops-bot: Quota request 5873 status changed: "In Review by GCP Support" — https://console.cloud.google.com/support/cases/5873

maria: If support doesn't move fast, fallback plan: spin up 8x A100-80GB with GPUDirect in apac-southeast1 (if quota exists) or apac-west1. Expect ~20% higher latency on the shard syncs. I opened PR #4321 with the config change.

aj: I pushed a tiny Terraform change to terraform/prod/gke/accelerators.tf to add the accelerator quota request under the shared-vpc project. Snippet:
```hcl
resource "google_project_service" "accelerator" {
  project = var.shared_vpc_project
  service = "compute.googleapis.com"
}
resource "google_compute_quota_override" "h100" {
  project = var.shared_vpc_project
  metric  = "GPUS"
  limit   = 8
}
```

Need someone to review IAM/service-account role binding too — that part touches the shared-vpc service account. Ping @ken for review.

ken: I'll take a look in ~30m. One note: if we route some jobs to eu-west1 we need to enable cross-region KV caching to keep tokenization latency predictable.

saurav: Cross-region adds ~70–90ms median on our test harness; still under 250ms SLO for batch loads, but not ideal for low-latency interactive tests. For the planned loadtest it's acceptable.

leah: Nimbus can expedite for staging only (2 racks) if legal signs NDA. Do we want to pursue that to get RDMA earlier for the pre-run?

aj: Decision proposal — (A) borrow 4x demo pool + request quota bump for remaining 4, and (B) ask procurement to initiate NDA with Nimbus as a contingency. @maria can you open the infra procurement ticket with PR-9442 and link NDA option?

maria: Done — created INFRA-2026, attached PR-9442, GCP case 5873, and Nimbus contact. Assigned to @leah for follow-up. Link: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INFRA-2026

ken: :thumbsup: I'll review the Terraform PR (4321) and post inline comments.

aj: Thanks — I'll hold off on scheduling the full multi-node run until we confirm quota or get the demo-borrow confirmed. If anyone hears from GCP support, drop updates here.

vendor-nimbus: Hi all — Nimbus confirms staging expedite requires signed NDA + PO. We can provision the 2-rack staging within 10 business days after paper. Contact: sales@nimbus.example.com

maria: Noted — adding Nimbus contact to INFRA-2026. Will loop in legal.

aj: Great, thanks everyone. I'll also add a one-line note to the runbook about RDMA vs GPUDirect perf deltas so QA isn't surprised.

ops-bot: Reminder: please include quota request IDs in all procurement tickets to speed tracking."
